title: Detailed roller skate
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Boot upper -->
  <path d='M25 30 Q25 20 35 18 L60 18 Q70 18 70 28 L70 50 Q70 55 65 55 L30 55 Q22 55 22 45 Z' fill='#FF6B9D' stroke='#FF9DC0' stroke-width='2'/>

  <path d='M35 18 L45 18 L48 35 L38 35 Z' fill='#FFD93D' stroke='#FFEB80' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <line x1='36' y1='24' x2='47' y2='24' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='37' y1='30' x2='48' y2='30' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='36' x2='49' y2='36' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Ankle collar / cuff -->
  <path d='M22 45 Q22 55 30 55 L65 55 Q72 55 72 48 L72 42 Q72 50 65 50 L30 50 Q24 50 24 42 Z' fill='#6BCB77' stroke='#9AEEA3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Boot heel -->
  <path d='M28 55 L28 62 L42 62 L42 55 Z' fill='#FF6B9D' stroke='#FF9DC0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Sole plate -->
  <rect x='20' y='60' width='55' height='6' rx='3' fill='#4D96FF' stroke='#85B8FF' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Front truck -->
  <rect x='25' y='66' width='12' height='5' rx='2' fill='#9B72CF' stroke='#C4A5E8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Back truck -->
  <rect x='55' y='66' width='12' height='5' rx='2' fill='#9B72CF' stroke='#C4A5E8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Front axle -->
  <line x1='23' y1='72' x2='39' y2='72' stroke='#FFD93D' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Back axle -->
  <line x1='53' y1='72' x2='69' y2='72' stroke='#FFD93D' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Front wheels -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='76' r='6' fill='#FF9F45' stroke='#FFC285' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#FFE0B5'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='76' r='6' fill='#FF9F45' stroke='#FFC285' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#FFE0B5'/>
  <!-- Back wheels -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='76' r='6' fill='#FF9F45' stroke='#FFC285' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#FFE0B5'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='76' r='6' fill='#FF9F45' stroke='#FFC285' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#FFE0B5'/>
  <!-- Toe stop -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='70' r='4' fill='#FF4D4D' stroke='#FF8A8A' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Toe cap accent -->
  <path d='M22 30 Q22 22 32 20 L35 20 L35 30 Z' fill='#FFD93D' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Star decoration on boot -->
  <path d='M52 32 L53.5 36 L58 36.5 L54.5 39.5 L55.5 44 L52 41.5 L48.5 44 L49.5 39.5 L46 36.5 L50.5 36 Z' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.9'/>
